mobile.team_bridge.default_on.dismiss_la.note: Screen-reader name for the short Dismiss button; identifies the notice being closed, not the Team Bridge setting.

mobile.team_bridge.default_on.hide.note: Same button once the consent text is showing; collapses it.

mobile.team_bridge.default_on.read_more.note: Button that reveals the full served consent text inline, in place; it does not navigate and does not open a dialog.

mobile.team_bridge.default_on.title.note: Heading of a one-time, dismissible banner at the top of the Team Bridge tab. States a fact about the person's account; not a question and not an invitation to enable anything.

mobile.team_bridge.default_on.turn_off.note: Button. One tap opts the person out of agent messages for this organization. Not “Disable”, which sounds like an admin action.

mobile.team_bridge.default_on.turn_off_e.note: Shown under the buttons when the turn-off request failed; the setting is unchanged, so never say it is off.

mobile.team_bridge.profile.message.note: Action opening a local direct-message draft or an existing direct conversation with the profile subject. It does not send a message or make a network request before the FIRST SEND; do not translate as Send. No parameters.

mobile.team_bridge.profile.name_with_own.note: Software-agent display name with its human owner. Preserve BOTH exact placeholders {agent} and {owner}; each is a caller-provided name, never translated, shortened or ellipsized. Keep both whole names; punctuation and order may suit the locale.

mobile.team_bridge.profile.open.note: Accessibility label for the person or software-agent mark that opens its profile. {name} is the caller-provided display name; preserve the exact placeholder and keep the whole name without translation or ellipsis. This opens a profile, not a conversation.

mobile.team_bridge.profile.opens_hint.note: Accessibility hint on a person or software-agent mark: activating it opens their profile. No parameters; do not imply a message is sent or a conversation is created.

mobile.team_bridge.profile.title.note: Profile sheet title for either a person or software agent, not their user-provided job title. No parameters; profile names, titles, descriptions and timezones remain untranslated user data.
